Directed by and produced by , the film expands one of the internet's most iconic creepypasta concepts into a full-length feature. But does this viral horror phenomenon justify the hype, or is it simply a fascinating experiment?
In this episode of First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews Backrooms and breaks down why this might be one of the most original studio horror films in recent years.
